text:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired: AUTH_SIGNING_FAILURE (pager id PD-9921)
pagerduty: PagerDuty notification: page triggered for service "auth-service-signing" — urgent
alex (oncall): acked. I'm on it.
alex (oncall): seeing spike in 401s from production. Dashboard: auth-signing error rate 18% in last 5m.
maria (auth): I can jump in. Any error samples?
jamie (sre): getting the logs now. Also routing rules show rollbacks attempted earlier but no recent deploys.
alex (oncall): sample error in logs:
```json
{"ts":"2026-03-15T10:02:11Z","service":"auth-service","err":"invalid token signature","kid":"key-unknown"}
```
maria (auth): that "kid" doesn't match current JWKS keys we have in KMS. Possible JWKS propagation / cache issue.
irene (eng-lead): tagging infra, could be edge cache or CDN serving stale keys. @jamie can you confirm JWKS endpoint health?
jamie (sre): hitting the JWKS endpoint: response 200 but payload shows an old key alongside new key. TTL on jwks-cache is 300s. I see repeated 502s to key-rotator pod earlier.
statusbot: incident-bot created incident-4832 and started an incident channel.
alex (oncall): immediate mitigation idea: route verification to fallback signing pool that uses KMS direct. risks?
maria (auth): that fallback path exists but needs a config flip in auth-configmap. I can roll it but will require a short restart.
jamie (sre): agree safe if we do canary first. We'll restart 1 pod in auth-service pool and monitor.
alex (oncall): doing canary restart now: `kubectl rollout restart deploy/auth-service -n prod --selector=pod-index=1`
(90s later)
alex (oncall): canary pod restarted, health probes passing. Error rate for that shard dropped to ~1% immediately.
maria (auth): flipping config to enable KMS-direct verification fallback for all pods. Patch applied to configmap `auth-config-v2` and rolling restart started.
jamie (sre): rolling restart progress: 3/20 pods restarted, no regression seen. Metrics show overall sign-failure rate dropping.
(5m later)
alex (oncall): PagerDuty note: ack persisted. escalations suppressed.
irene (eng-lead): customer impact: partial token validation failures affecting ~1200 requests/min to the API gateway. Most requests get retried by clients; downstream errors visible in a subset of customers (mostly mobile). Need comms.
maria (auth): root cause hypothesis: key-rotator experienced transient DB timeouts at 09:58 which prevented the new key from being published to secondary JWKS caches; subsequent cache invalidation didn't propagate due to a bug (missing Content-Length header) in the propagation worker.
jamie (sre): logs for key-rotator failure snippet:
```
[09:58:03] ERROR rotator: push failed: db: timeout
[09:58:04] WARN rotator: retrying...
[09:58:07] ERROR propagator: http post failed: 502 Bad Gateway (missing content-length)
```
alex (oncall): mitigation status: fallback enabled globally, sign-failure rate down to 0.7%. Rolling restarts complete.
irene (eng-lead): good. Prepare customer comms: short status update + ETA for full remediation and postmortem. Draft?
maria (auth): drafting: "We experienced intermittent token validation errors caused by JWKS propagation failures; mitigation applied (KMS-direct fallback). Full root cause and remediation plan in progress."
alex (oncall): I'll create and update the incident in the status page. Setting status to partial outage for auth validation.
statusbot: status page updated: Auth token validation — partial outage (mitigated).
jamie (sre): scheduling follow-up: revert fallback path after we fix propagation worker and validate keys fully. Also a canary for outgoing propagation.
irene (eng-lead): assign owners: maria -> root cause and fix, jamie -> infra/propagator hardening, alex -> incident writeup + customer comms.
maria (auth): ack. I'll instrument additional checks: jwks checksum, propagation acknowledgements, and increase propagation worker retries.
alex (oncall): handing off to daytime oncall @irene for any followups. My shift ends in 20m but I'll stay until the postmortem draft is done.
irene (eng-lead): thanks, alex. we'll keep this thread for followups. tagging PD: please don't auto-escalate further unless error rate >2% for 10m.
pagerduty: PagerDuty: page resolved (ack by alex (oncall)) — escalation paused.
incident-bot: incident-4832 updated: mitigation in place, postmortem required.
alex (oncall): final note: workaround is not a permanent fix. Do not rotate JWKS keys until maria says propagation is fixed.
maria (auth): noted. starting a runbook PR with the propagation fix and tests.
irene (eng-lead): thanks everyone. postmortem owner: maria. timeline doc to be created in /docs/incidents/4832.
